title: Lead I - Enterprise Solutions - Sr. ServiceNow SecOps Developer
description: Role description Job Description: The Sr. ServiceNow SecOps Developer designs, develops and supports ServiceNow Security Operations, with a strong focus on Vulnerability Response (VR). The role requires deep, hands-on technical expertise in VR implementations integrated with Rapid7 and Wiz, supported by advanced platform scripting and integration skills. The developer delivers scalable solutions through configuration, integration, automation and customization, following ServiceNow best practices. The developer also contributes to general platform features as needed and works closely with security teams, platform teams and the BSA. Primary skillset: ServiceNow SecOps (Host, Application, Container VR - preferably Rapid7 and Wiz), Advanced Platform Scripting, Integrations Key Responsibilities • VR design and development (Host, Application, Container): Design, build and support VR solutions covering the data model, Vulnerable Items, Vulnerability Groups, calculators and risk scoring. Also build remediation task and assignment rules, SLAs, and exception and deferral workflows. • Rapid7 and Wiz integrations: Implement, customize and troubleshoot the Rapid7 and Wiz integrations. This covers data ingestion, import sets and transform maps, CI lookup and reconciliation, scheduled import jobs, and handling of high-volume data loads, including performance and failure scenarios. • Prioritization and remediation: Configure and enhance prioritization, remediation tracking and reporting. Tune CI lookup rules so findings map correctly to CIs, applications and services. • Integrations: Build and maintain integrations with third-party tools and enterprise systems using REST APIs, spokes, IntegrationHub and MID Server. • Advanced platform scripting: Develop with Business Rules, Script Includes, Scheduled Jobs, Fix Scripts, Client Scripts, UI Policies and ACLs. Optimize GlideRecord and GlideAggregate queries and long-running jobs. • Automation: Design and support Flow Designer and legacy Workflow automations for SecOps and platform processes. • Troubleshooting: Analyze and resolve issues across VR functionality, integrations, scripting and automation, including root cause analysis for production defects. • Collaboration: Work with security teams, platform teams, stakeholders and vendors on requirements and solutions. Provide clear documentation, take part in design discussions and give the BSA proactive status updates. Required Skills • Strong hands-on VR experience for host, application and container vulnerabilities, with in-depth knowledge of the VR data model and remediation lifecycle. • Hands-on experience integrating Rapid7 and Wiz with ServiceNow VR in production. • Advanced JavaScript and server-side ServiceNow APIs (GlideRecord, GlideAjax, GlideSystem, scoped APIs). • Strong integration skills with REST/SOAP, JSON/XML, OAuth, Import Sets, Transform Maps, MID Server and IntegrationHub. • Working knowledge of CMDB, Discovery and CI relationships, and of CVE/CVSS and vulnerability risk concepts. • Experience with Flow Designer, Workflow, Service Catalog. • Strong communication and documentation skills. Preferred Skills • ServiceNow CSA, CAD or Vulnerability Response Implementation Specialist certification. • Experience with VR Performance Analytics. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain web applications using Python and Django framework Design and build RESTful APIs for integration with frontend and third-party services Deploy, manage, and scale applications on AWS cloud infrastructure Work with AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudWatch Develop secure, scalable, and high-performance applications Optimize database queries and ensure efficient data management Collaborate with front-end developers, DevOps teams, and stakeholders Implement authentication, authorization, and data protection mechanisms Write clean, reusable, and testable code Troubleshoot and resolve application issues Participate in code reviews and improve development standards Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related field Proven experience as a Python Developer Strong expertise in Django framework Experience in building and consuming REST APIs (Django REST Framework preferred) Hands-on experience with AWS services Strong knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) Familiarity with ORM (Django ORM) Understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) and design principles Proficiency with Git/version control systems Experience with Linux environments Preferred Skills Experience with serverless architecture (AWS Lambda) Knowledge of Docker and containerization Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.) Experience with microservices architecture Knowledge of NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, MongoDB) Exposure to frontend technologies (React, Angular) is a plus Understanding of caching tools (Redis, Memcached)Role & responsibilities.
